name: Huseyn Shaheed Suhrawardy
seoTitle: Huseyn Shaheed Suhrawardy - Bengal Chief Minister and Pakistan Prime Minister
seoDescription: Profile of Huseyn Shaheed Suhrawardy, covering his role in late colonial Bengal, Direct Action Day, the United Bengal proposal, and Pakistan constitutional politics.
shortAnswer: A Bengal and Pakistan politician whose career spanned Calcutta labour politics, Bengal's last undivided ministry, the United Bengal proposal, and Pakistan's premiership.
contribution: As Bengal's last undivided premier, he was a central actor in late colonial crisis politics and a leading advocate of the United Bengal proposal.
impact: He shaped the debate over whether Bengal would remain united, be partitioned, or seek an independent path.

faq.question: Why is Huseyn Shaheed Suhrawardy central to the partition-era timeline?
faq.answer: He was Bengal's last undivided chief minister, was linked to the Direct Action Day crisis, and later supported the unsuccessful United Bengal proposal before entering Pakistan politics.
